question.text: The CAPITAL MARKET LINE (CML) represents the set of portfolios:

answer.text: All combinations of the risk-free asset and the MARKET PORTFOLIO (optimum risky portfolio)
All portfolios below the efficient frontier

explanation.text: The Logic: CML = line from risk-free rate to the tangent point (Market Portfolio) on the efficient frontier. It dominates all other risky portfolios when a risk-free asset exists. The Trap: CML is a specific line; efficient frontier is a curve. Cross-Exam Context: Core CMT. Manager's Pro-Tip: Passive investing is essentially 'choose a point on the CML' — allocating between cash and the market portfolio (index fund).
